en: The Questions of King Milinda, Chapter on Investigation, 8. The Question on the Characteristic of Contact (Phassalakkhaṇapañha) “Venerable sir, what is the characteristic of contact? “Great king, the characteristic of contact is touching. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of touching? “Great king, the characteristic of touching is the state of having made contact. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having made contact? “Great king, the characteristic of having made contact is the state of having reached. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having reached? “Great king, the characteristic of having reached is the state of having arrived. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having arrived? “Great king, the characteristic of having arrived is the state of having come together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having come together? “Great king, the characteristic of having come together is the state of having met. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having met? “Great king, the characteristic of having met is the state of having encountered. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having encountered? “Great king, the characteristic of having encountered is the state of having come face to face. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having come face to face? “Great king, the characteristic of having come face to face is the state of having conjoined. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having conjoined? “Great king, the characteristic of having conjoined is the state of having been brought together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been brought together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been brought together is the state of having been united. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been united? “Great king, the characteristic of having been united is the state of having been combined. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been combined? “Great king, the characteristic of having been combined is the state of having been joined. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been joined? “Great king, the characteristic of having been joined is the state of having been linked. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been linked? “Great king, the characteristic of having been linked is the state of having been bound together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been bound together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been bound together is the state of having been fastened together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been fastened together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been fastened together is the state of having been tied together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been tied together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been tied together is the state of having been knotted together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been knotted together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been knotted together is the state of having been interwoven. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been interwoven? “Great king, the characteristic of having been interwoven is the state of having been woven together. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been woven together? “Great king, the characteristic of having been woven together is the state of having been interlaced. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been interlaced? “Great king, the characteristic of having been interlaced is the state of having been intertwined. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been intertwined? “Great king, the characteristic of having been intertwined is the state of having been entangled. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been entangled? “Great king, the characteristic of having been entangled is the state of having been ensnared. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been ensnared? “Great king, the characteristic of having been ensnared is the state of having been caught. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been caught? “Great king, the characteristic of having been caught is the state of having been seized. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been seized? “Great king, the characteristic of having been seized is the state of having been grasped. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been grasped? “Great king, the characteristic of having been grasped is the state of having been held. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been held? “Great king, the characteristic of having been held is the state of having been maintained. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been maintained? “Great king, the characteristic of having been maintained is the state of having been sustained. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been sustained? “Great king, the characteristic of having been sustained is the state of having been supported. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been supported? “Great king, the characteristic of having been supported is the state of having been upheld. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been upheld? “Great king, the characteristic of having been upheld is the state of having been established. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been established? “Great king, the characteristic of having been established is the state of having been fixed. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been fixed? “Great king, the characteristic of having been fixed is the state of having been settled. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been settled? “Great king, the characteristic of having been settled is the state of having been determined. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been determined? “Great king, the characteristic of having been determined is the state of having been resolved. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been resolved? “Great king, the characteristic of having been resolved is the state of having been decided. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been decided? “Great king, the characteristic of having been decided is the state of having been concluded. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been concluded?

“Great king, the characteristic of having been concluded is the state of having been finalized. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been finalized? “Great king, the characteristic of having been finalized is the state of having been completed. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been completed? “Great king, the characteristic of having been completed is the state of having been finished. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been finished? “Great king, the characteristic of having been finished is the state of having been accomplished. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been accomplished? “Great king, the characteristic of having been accomplished is the state of having been achieved. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been achieved? “Great king, the characteristic of having been achieved is the state of having been realized. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been realized? “Great king, the characteristic of having been realized is the state of having been attained. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been attained? “Great king, the characteristic of having been attained is the state of having been reached. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been reached? “Great king, the characteristic of having been reached is the state of having been arrived at. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been arrived at? “Great king, the characteristic of having been arrived at is the state of having been entered into. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been entered into? “Great king, the characteristic of having been entered into is the state of having been penetrated. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been penetrated? “Great king, the characteristic of having been penetrated is the state of having been pierced through. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been pierced through? “Great king, the characteristic of having been pierced through is the state of having been broken through. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been broken through? “Great king, the characteristic of having been broken through is the state of having been shattered. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been shattered? “Great king, the characteristic of having been shattered is the state of having been destroyed. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been destroyed? “Great king, the characteristic of having been destroyed is the state of having been eliminated. “But, venerable sir, what is the characteristic of having been eliminated? The King said:
"Venerable Nāgasena, where mental consciousness arises, do contact and feeling also arise there?
"Yes, Great King, where mental consciousness arises, contact also arises there, and feeling also arises."
“Therein perception arises, therein volition arises, therein applied thought arises,
therein sustained thought arises, and all phenomena headed by contact arise therein.
“Venerable Nāgasena, what is the characteristic of contact?”
“Contact, great king, has the characteristic of touching.
“Give me an illustration,” he said.
“Just as, great king, two rams might fight; there, the eye should be regarded as being like one of those rams.”
“As the second ram is, so should form be regarded.
As their meeting is, so should contact be regarded.
“Give me a further simile.”
“Great King, just as two hands might strike together: therein, the eye is to be regarded as like one hand;
visible form is to be regarded as like the second hand;
and contact is to be regarded as like their collision.”
“Give me yet another simile.
“Just as if, Great King, two dice were thrown: just as one die is false, so should the eye be regarded;
just as the second die is false, so should visible form be regarded.”
"Just as their coming together is, so should contact be regarded.
"Excellent, venerable Nāgasena!
This is the eighth dilemma, concerning the characteristic of contact.
